mapper.sql: SELECT MAX(x.id) AS latest_id FROM answer_sheet x WHERE x.exam_id = #{examId} AND x.status IN (2, 3, 4) GROUP BY x.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS attended_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= p.pass_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_count, AVG(s.total_score) AS avg_score, MAX(s.total_score) AS max_score, MIN(s.total_score) AS min_score FROM answer_sheet s JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id = s.paper_id JOIN () t ON t.latest_id = s.id

SELECT CASE WHEN s.total_score / p.total_score >= 0.9 THEN 1 WHEN s.total_score / p.total_score >= 0.8 THEN 2 WHEN s.total_score / p.total_score >= 0.7 THEN 3 WHEN s.total_score / p.total_score >= 0.6 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS level, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM answer_sheet s JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id = s.paper_id JOIN () t ON t.latest_id = s.id GROUP BY level ORDER BY level
mapper.update: UPDATE answer_sheet s JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id = s.paper_id SET s.is_passed = CASE WHEN s.total_score >= p.pass_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE s.exam_id = #{examId} AND s.status IN (2, 3, 4) AND s.total_score IS NOT NULL
